subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: May this PR establish the grouped Claw v1 read-only contract now, with immutable install identity deferred but required before the mutating provenance stack lands?
rationale: The code can be reviewed mechanically, but accepting a foundational schema and identity boundary for several dependent pull requests requires maintainer intent while the governing RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve base; gate mutation identity
options.body: Accept the read-only schema after exact-head proof, but require the immutable install identity decision before the dependent add and provenance slices merge.

options.title: Add install identity now
options.body: Expand this PR to include an immutable install identifier in the v1 plan contract before downstream consumers depend on mutable agent identity.

options.title: Pause for RFC approval
options.body: Keep this and the dependent stack open until the Claws RFC settles the complete schema and lifecycle identity model.

recommendation.title: Approve base; gate mutation identity
recommendation.body: Accept the read-only schema after exact-head proof, but require the immutable install identity decision before the dependent add and provenance slices merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He raised the unresolved identity boundary from a concrete downstream consumer perspective and is therefore the clearest available owner for this specific decision.
